title: Family Beach Picnic at Laguna, 1950s Snapshot B&W California
back_text_transcription: JUN 10 1952 H.M.A at Laguna (on a Nice Day) with The Geigers 680
description: A 1952 black-and-white snapshot depicting a family enjoying a seaside picnic on the beach in Laguna Beach, California. The group is seated on the sand in front of coastal hills.
